rows.definition: The constant /dev/dri/renderD128 - the primary Linux DRM render node used by the Strix KFD allocators on AMDGPU GFX1151.
rows.distinction: A device-path constant; it is not the accessibility probe (ProbeDRMRenderNode), not the Vulkan backend node-identity reporter (VulkanDRMRenderNode), and not the allocator config field RenderPath that carries this value.

rows.definition: The 16 MiB byte cap on materialized Jinja template output enforced by the agent in-kernel Jinja runtime and builtins.
rows.distinction: A size bound on template materialization; it neither plans or pages context (MaterializePlan) nor bounds lazy weight reads (q4kMaterializeWindowBytes).

rows.definition: The model-arch step that maps NanBeige's 22 physical block tensors across recurrent loops so shared weights are materialized once.
rows.distinction: An architecture-specific weight mapping at load time; it is not the GGUF-load MTP bookkeeping marker (mtpMaterialized) and not a lazy-read byte window (q4kMaterializeWindowBytes).

rows.definition: The plan-materialization entry points that turn a reuse plan into concrete state: ctxplan.materializePlan builds a View over spans, while radixkv.MaterializePlan fences and materializes a ReusePlan against candidate compatibility fences.
rows.distinction: It materializes a context-reuse plan; it is not the prompt-assembly layout (RenderPlan), not memq cell rendering (RenderItem), and not a Jinja byte cap (jinjaMaxMaterialized).

rows.definition: The tensorWork field recording the canonical name of the Qwen3.5 MTP module materialized during GGUF loading, feeding validateQwen35MTPMaterialized.
rows.distinction: A load-time bookkeeping marker for MTP weights; it is not the validation function itself (validateQwen35MTPMaterialized) and not a lazy-read byte window (q4kMaterializeWindowBytes).

rows.definition: The shared parse-and-execute helper behind fak node-install's three unit renderers (plist, systemd unit, Windows runner), also reused for garden-plist.
rows.distinction: It executes a Go text/template for service units; it does not format wave-plan reports (RenderWaves) and does not render session cards to HTML (renderSessionCardsHTML).

rows.definition: The stopgate BoundaryInput flag set when the assistant's final message is detected as a surrender note via stopgate.IsSurrenderNote.
rows.distinction: A boolean detection outcome; the raw content it derives from sits in SurrenderNote, and the detector predicate is IsSurrenderNote.

rows.definition: The KFD allocator probe that checks whether a DRM render node exists and is accessible, returning a DRMAccessProbeResult (defaulting to DefaultDRMRenderPath).
rows.distinction: A one-shot accessibility probe; it is not the default path constant (DefaultDRMRenderPath) and not the Vulkan backend's node-identity reporter (VulkanDRMRenderNode).

rows.definition: The 64 MiB constant bounding each non-mmap lazy ReadAt request when materializing Q4K quantized weights.
rows.distinction: A per-request read-window bound for lazy quant loading; it is not the Jinja output cap (jinjaMaxMaterialized) and not a weight-mapping step (MaterializeNanbeigeSharedWeights).

rows.definition: The wire value of relay's WipRematerialized RematerializeVerdict: a WipTree delta was re-applied cleanly onto the working tree.
rows.distinction: A WipTree re-apply verdict string; it is not the paged-prefix CoW counter RematerializedBytes and not a ctxplan/radixkv plan materialization (MaterializePlan).

rows.definition: The flowmetrics writer that renders the human-readable arrival-vs-service report; RenderIntakeReport is an alias for it.
rows.distinction: A metrics readout printer; it does not fold CLI usage journals into fleet exposition (renderFleetCLIUsageExposition) and does not format debt-lane reports (RenderCrossIndex).

rows.definition: The debtlane formatter that renders a Report focusing on cross-indexed related items and companions.
rows.distinction: A debt-lane cross-reference view; it is not the wave-plan terminal formatter (RenderWaves) and not perfscout's cross-innovation reports (RenderCrossInnovationsJSON/Markdown).

rows.definition: The perfscout formatter that serializes CrossInnovation entries as indented JSON.
rows.distinction: The machine-readable half of the cross-innovation pair; its human Markdown twin is RenderCrossInnovationsMarkdown.

rows.definition: The perfscout formatter that renders CrossInnovation entries as a formatted Markdown report.
rows.distinction: The human-readable half of the cross-innovation pair; its machine JSON twin is RenderCrossInnovationsJSON.

rows.definition: The Linux DRM render-node device-path prefix /dev/dri/renderD checked by the llamacppinterop comparator authority and formatted as renderD<minor> in host-environment DRM verification.
rows.distinction: A device-path fragment naming a card's render node; it is not the full default path constant (DefaultDRMRenderPath), not the concrete card-0 node name (renderD128), and not the generic render verb.

rows.definition: The concrete Linux DRM render-node device name /dev/dri/renderD128 (card 0) used as the default KFD/UMA render path on Strix AMDGPU hosts.
rows.distinction: The specific card-0 render node; it is the value of DefaultDRMRenderPath but not the constant itself, the probe function, or the bare renderD prefix.

rows.definition: The issuesolved report mode that writes the summary plus issue numbers, titles, and timestamps grouped by repository.
rows.distinction: One of the three issuesolved output modes (JSON/Detailed/Summary); it is not the duplicate-fix advisory printer (RenderDuplicateFixes).

rows.definition: The safesync writer that prints advisory lines for duplicate fixes found against upstream (nothing when empty).
rows.distinction: Trunk-red claim advisory output; it is not the issuesolved detailed report (RenderDetailed).

rows.definition: The conventional local error binding returned by native chat-template and prompt-encoding render calls (agent/prompt_encoding, ggufload quant-integrity, issues-solved CLI).
rows.distinction: A failure channel out of a render call; it is not the short device-path fragment renderD, not the RendererID receipt field, and not the Rendered ctxplan span paging.

rows.definition: The macobs hardware telemetry gauge reporting GPU renderer utilization as a percentage (json renderer_utilization_pct).
rows.distinction: A reported utilization percentage; it is not a render function and not the fleet CLI usage journal fold (renderFleetCLIUsageExposition).

rows.definition: The cmd/fak section that folds the local CLI-invocation usage journal into the fleet-metrics exposition text.
rows.distinction: A usage-journal fold appended to fleet metrics; it is not the arrival/service readout (RenderArrivalServiceReadout) and not a utilization gauge (RendererUtilizationPct).

rows.definition: The InKernelPlanner method that renders admitted messages and tools into tokenizer segments via the native Jinja chat template.
rows.distinction: In-kernel prompt assembly; it is not the Jinja byte cap (jinjaMaxMaterialized), not the DeepSeek V4.1 chat renderer, and not the gateway upstream template-render error code.

rows.definition: The KFD allocator config field (json render_path) carrying the DRM render-node path, defaulted to DefaultDRMRenderPath and consumed by the UMA zero-copy allocator.
rows.distinction: A config field holding a device path; it is not the default constant itself (DefaultDRMRenderPath), not the probe (ProbeDRMRenderNode), and not the generic render verb.

rows.definition: The fak-dev bench subagent-fanout pretty-printer that writes a SubagentFanoutReceipt to stdout.
rows.distinction: A bench receipt printer; it is not the agent receipt+verification-verdict renderer (RenderReceipt) and not the issues-solved detailed report (RenderDetailed).

rows.definition: The harnessweb renderer that turns session cards into HTML markup; also the captured-render witness seam for the web surface.
rows.distinction: An HTML card renderer for the harness web UI; it is not the shared install-unit template executor (nodeRenderUnit) and not a TUI pane renderer.

rows.definition: The terminal-text formatters for wave plans, present in both debtlane (WavePlan + ProductionGrade) and issueorchestrator (Plan).
rows.distinction: Human wave-plan output; it is not the cross-index report view (RenderCrossIndex) and not the dispatch-wave plan-row materializer (renderDispatchWavePlanRows).

rows.definition: The run-end flag phrase matched by headlesslint's surrender-detection regex (i surrender | surrendering) marking a session that gave up mid-task.
rows.distinction: A prose flag word linted at run end; it is not the stopgate boundary fields (NotedSurrender/SurrenderNote) and not the detector predicate (IsSurrenderNote).

rows.definition: The stopgate BoundaryInput field holding the raw assistant content examined for surrender-note detection.
rows.distinction: The raw content input; the derived boolean is NotedSurrender and the predicate is IsSurrenderNote.

rows.definition: The host-environment/Vulkan backend method reporting the DRM render-node identity (major/minor) of the initialized Vulkan device.
rows.distinction: A device-identity reporter on the live Vulkan backend; it is not the KFD path constant (DefaultDRMRenderPath), not the existence probe (ProbeDRMRenderNode), and not the config field (RenderPath).
